integrity: Self-contained subgroup-count proof and explicit no-carry base-p inverse. Exact rational checker independently enumerated 3445 partition cases and 40 small groups; finite checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.
limitations: Exact membership criterion is for noncyclic finite abelian prime-power groups only, not all finite groups; cyclic groups all have probability one. Absolute historical priority is not independently certified. The fixed-order injectivity consequence is prior coverage through element-order sums.
title: The digit-language spectrum of cyclic-pair probabilities in finite abelian \(p\)-groups
